message: 天使の寝息
Even after that, Amyrina continued to visit my house frequently along with Lolotte.
Since she was always coming over with Lolotte, I'd thought the two of them must be two peas in a pod, but...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「She's asleep again...\s02」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte is always bursting with energy. That's why she always tires herself out playing and falls asleep right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not like that, Amyrina?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Sleeping in front of other people is... a little embarrassing.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. You and Lolotte really are different after all, huh.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Different... you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. The two of you are close, and I guess you have some things in common, but... when you look closely, you're totally different.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's the first time anyone has ever told me that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Most angels lack individuality. Because of that, everyone tends to look the exact same.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Perhaps Lolotte grew bored of that sameness, and came to admire the Human World, where all sorts of unique individuals live.」

name: Synn
message: 「True. Lolotte's got plenty of personality herself.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, angels operate on the idea that crushing individuality eliminates malice.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A-Angel?! I'm not an angel!\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're dead ringers when it comes to being airheads, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's just me and Paqy here anyway... so don't push yourself when you're tired, okay?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. Thank you very much for your consideration.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Planning to attack her while she's asleep? Smooth move, man.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh, wha--\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「If that were the case, I would've already attacked Lolotte.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You already attacked her?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. That's not what I meant\s02」
Well, though, I wouldn't mind seeing Amyrina's peaceful sleeping face every once in a while.
I'm sure it would be super cute.
